optimizedDescription.value: Pure bounded traversal computes filtered deterministic blast radius, risk, hierarchy, and requirement coverage.

optimizedContext.value:
# Traversal

## Rules
- `getUpstream` follows reverse `CALLS`; `getDownstream` follows forward `CALLS`. Default `maxDepth: 3`; group results 1-indexed by depth; cycle dedupe at shallowest visit.
- `TraversalOptions`: `maxDepth`, `includeFiles` default true. `TraversalResult`: root, depth map, unique total, truncation flag.
- BFS batches each frontier through `GraphStore` symbol/relation batch APIs; no call per symbol/type. File/multi-file/change aggregation uses fixed bounded concurrency. Multi-file shares memoized read view and budget. Width must not cause `StoreOverloadError`.
- Hotspots fetch all candidates' incoming `EXTENDS`/`IMPLEMENTS`/`OVERRIDES` in one logical batch, fold counts in memory; preserve scoring, filtering, rank, risk.
- `analyzeImpact` returns target; direct depth-1, indirect depth-2, transitive depth-3+ counts; risk; unique files; depth-bearing symbols; processes; required `affectedSpecs`; `omittedCounts: { tests, ignored }`.
- Dependency traversal treats `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` as direction-aware equal blast-radius edges.
- Optional typed impact filter applies across symbol/file/multi-file/spec/public-binding: result types `files|symbols|specs`, symbol kinds, included/excluded workspaces, admitted categories. Categories default `['source']`; exclusions win; empty inclusion admits all.
- Backend filtered-impact queries enforce type/kind/category/workspace eligibility before collection/count/risk/limits. Never fetch unrestricted candidates for service/CLI post-filtering.
- Upstream/bidirectional BFS stops at non-admitted file boundaries; excluded tests/ignored files cannot bridge production paths or inflate counts/risk. Explicit test/ignored target may traverse downstream.
- Result-type selection controls materialized collections without changing required reachability. Specs-only still traverses admitted code evidence. `affectedSpecs` empty unless requested; then derive from admitted `COVERS_FILE`/`COVERS_SYMBOL`. Filtering precedes limits.
- Risk: LOW=0–2 direct and no indirect; MEDIUM=3–5 direct or any indirect; HIGH=6+ direct or 10+ total; CRITICAL=20+ total or target in 3+ flows.
- `analyzeFileImpact`: load file symbols, bounded per-symbol impact, dedupe shallowest symbols, union files/spec evidence, max risk. `analyzeFilesImpact`: aggregate files/symbols, sum depth counts, max risk; all inputs depth 0.
- `coveringSpecs`: batch reverse coverage for input/reached files and symbols; one spec with minimum depth plus every distinct `{ kind, target, depth }`; deterministic depth/spec/evidence order. File evidence independent; symbol evidence augments.
- `analyzeSpecImpact` traverses `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`; upstream returns dependent specs and their covered code; downstream returns dependencies and reachable code within depth.
- `detectChanges` finds changed-file symbols, bounded upstream impact, aggregate files/symbols/risk/summary.
- Resolve selector to one canonical logical target before traversal. Unqualified: case-exact, then case-insensitive exact only; never fuzzy/prefix/component. Ambiguity returns bounded ordered candidates without traversal.
- Owner-qualified selector uses resolver and stored `qualified_name`; zero matches never fall back to terminal name. Traversal consumes proven symbol ID and never parses human syntax.
- Public-binding impact separates exact surface/export-name consumers (including re-exports) from all canonical-symbol dependents; retain selected binding, canonical target, ordered chain; never merge ambiguous exports.
- Hierarchy traversal preserves language precedence/direction across contracts, overrides, inheritance, traits, mixins, embedding, promotion, provable interfaces; count logical symbol once; deterministic bounded cycle-safe order.
- All operations are stateless read-only functions in `domain/services/`.

## Constraints
- Default depth 3; caller override allowed.
- Fixed risk thresholds.
- Shallowest-depth cycle deduplication required.
- Bounded batching/concurrency required across width/input size.
- No store mutation, lifecycle management, retained state, or `@specd/core` dependency.
